people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Hamor
people.line: A Hivite prince, father of Shechem.

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: and they were brought back to Shechem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.
translations.bsb: Their bones were carried back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor at Shechem for a price he paid in silver.
translations.kjv: And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem.
translations.asv: and they were carried over unto Shechem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver of the sons of Hamor in Shechem.
